cs.t:
I picked up a Dell Inspiron 7000 17" and liked these details:
- Large 17" screen with slim design similar in size to many 15".
- 2560 x 1600 resolution. 4K is too small, 1920p not enough pixels.
- Dedicated Nvidia graphics.
- Effective keyboard for coding.
- Lower cost than XPS yet seemed more full featured. Battery life is somewhat lower due to the size and higher performance components. But seemed like a good trade-off in the end for the better coding experience.
cs.th: Ask HN: What’s a good laptop for software development at around $2k?
